tasks.title: Make cars pull up to stop line
tasks.description:
Make cars go slower in the traffic light region if the light is yellow or red, then fully stop at the line.
Other cars should stop behind them.

tasks.title: Have lights signal cars to go on green
tasks.description:
Have the traffic light send out a signal to all cars when a light turns green.
Signal carries info about which lights are green or which lights just turned green.
The car can figure out if it should go or not based on the signal.

tasks.title: Make cars avoid other cars
tasks.description:
Make cars slow down to match the car in front of them's speed.
Also have a minimum distance to car ahead so no tailgating.
Raycast ahead to find the car in front of you, then track its distance
